newsitem.title: USA: Apria ends planned Vitas merger.
newsitem.headline: Apria ends planned Vitas merger.

text.p: Apria Healthcare Group Inc said on Wednesday it had decided to end its planned merger with Vitas Healthcare Corp because certain deadlines were not met and it appears the deal would dilute earnings in 1997.
The companies announced an agreement to merge in June, but last week Apria, a homecare health provider, said it was considering terminating the deal.
Apria said it will record $4.0-$8.0 million in added fourth quarter expenses to account for the failed deal.

"It is unfortunate that discussions with Vitas did not result in an acceptable alternative relationship," Apria Chairman Jeremy Jones said in a statement. "(But) we believe the board's decision not to proceed with the merger is in the best interest of Apria shareholders."
